stem: A drinks stall in Lahore sells lassi for 150 rupees per glass and fresh juice for 200 rupees per glass. The equation \(150x + 200y = 6{,}000\) represents a day on which the stall sells \(x\) glasses of lassi and \(y\) glasses of juice for exactly 6,000 rupees. Which of the following points lies on the graph of this equation in the \(xy\)-plane and represents a day on which the stall sells 12 more glasses of lassi than juice?

explanation.A: Incorrect. This has 12 more glasses of juice than lassi, and \(150(12) + 200(24) = 6{,}600\), not \(6{,}000\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This point is on the graph (\(4{,}200 + 1{,}800 = 6{,}000\)), but \(28 - 9 = 19\), not 12.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This has 12 more lassi than juice, but \(150(20) + 200(8) = 4{,}600\), not \(6{,}000\).

verify:
pt = lambda s: [value(t) for t in s.replace('\\(', '').replace('\\)', '').strip()[1:-1].split(',')]
good = lambda p: 150*p[0] + 200*p[1] == 6000 and p[0] - p[1] == 12
ok = [k for k in choices if good(pt(choices[k]))]
assert ok == [answer]
